.. changelog::
    :tags: bug, sqlite, reflection
    :tickets: 11677, 11840

    Reworked SQLite CHECK constraint reflection to tokenize and parse the
    stored ``CREATE TABLE`` statement instead of relying on a regular
    expression.  CHECK constraints are now reflected correctly regardless of
    how the DDL was formatted by external tools, including constraints that
    span multiple lines, multiple constraints on a single line, column-level
    and table-level constraints, and expressions that contain nested
    parentheses, string literals, quoted identifiers, or SQL comments.
    Constraint expressions are preserved verbatim so that they remain valid,
    re-compilable SQL.
